title: Naviam Maximo Developer Tools Deployment File

properties.description: An array of Maximo properties to be deployed to the target system.

messages.description: An array of Maximo messages to be deployed to the target system.

loggers.description: An array of Maximo loggers to be deployed to the target system.

cronTasks.description: An array of Maximo cron tasks to be deployed to the target system.

domains.description: An array of Maximo domains to be deployed to the target system.

integrationObjects.description: An array of Maximo integration objects.

endPoints.description: An array of Maximo integration end points. The handler of an end point defines its properties, so only the values of existing properties are deployed.

publishChannels.description: An array of Maximo integration publish channels.

enterpriseServices.description: An array of Maximo integration enterprise services.

externalSystems.description: An array of Maximo integration external systems.

presentations.description: Ordered changes to existing application or system presentations, applied to the stored screen definition in place of deploying the whole screen.

objects.description: An array of Maximo objects to be deployed to the target system. The database configuration is applied after the deployment unless noDBConfig is set.

noDBConfig.description: Do not apply the database configuration after deploying objects; an administrator applies it later.

noAdminMode.description: Do not turn on Admin Mode when the database configuration requires it; an administrator applies the configuration later.

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the object should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of object settings whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the object already exists. Ignored when the object is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

object.description: The name for the Maximo object (MAXOBJECTCFG.OBJECTNAME)

description.description: The object description for the Maximo object (MAXOBJECTCFG.DESCRIPTION)

service.description: The Maximo service associated with the Maximo object. (MAXOBJECTCFG.SERVICENAME)

entity.description: The entity name for the Maximo object (MAXOBJECTCFG.ENTITYNAME)

class.description: The class name for the Maximo object (MAXOBJECTCFG.CLASSNAME)

extendsObject.description: The business object that the specified business object extends. Extend an object only when the corresponding entity of the specified business object is a view. (MAXOBJECTCFG.EXTENDSOBJECT)

level.description: The organizational level to which the object applies (MAXOBJECTCFG.SITEORGTYPE). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !SYSTEM!.
level.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !SYSTEM!.

textDirection.description: The orientation of text that you enter into fields (MAXOBJECTCFG.TEXTDIRECTION)

mainObject.description: Indicates a main object for business applications and workflows (MAXOBJECTCFG.MAINOBJECT)

loadDefaultAttributes.description: When true (default), Maximo auto-creates its default attributes for a new object: the DESCRIPTION attribute and the generated HASLD and DESCRIPTION_LONGDESCRIPTION attributes, along with the primary key/ID column. When false, Maximo skips creating these defaults, giving you full control over which attributes - including the primary key/ID column - are created; only the explicitly declared attributes are created (MaxObjectCfg.setLoadDefaultAttributes)

persistent.description: Indicates a persistent object that can be a view or a table. An object must be persistent for you to define an index on it (MAXOBJECTCFG.PERSISTENT)

storagePartition.description: Database dependent, named storage partition, for the table. This is Tablespace for Oracle and Segment for Microsoft SQLServer (MAXOBJECTCFG.STORAGEPARTITION)

uniqueColumn.description: Contains the name of the column that composes a one-column unique index on this table (MAXOBJECTCFG.UNIQUECOLUMNNAME)

languageTable.description: The name of this table's language table (MAXOBJECTCFG.LANGTABLENAME)

languageColumn.description: The name of the language column on this table (MAXOBJECTCFG.LANGCOLUMNNAME)

alternateIndex.description: Alternate index name for record identification by external systems, when primarykeycolseq or unique key are not appropriate (MAXOBJECTCFG.ALTIXNAME)

triggerRoot.description: Trigger name root. The actual trigger name will be composed of this root plus a suffix (MAXOBJECTCFG.TRIGROOT)

addRowstamp.description: Indicates whether this table should have a Rowstamp column (MAXOBJECTCFG.ADDROWSTAMP)

textSearchEnabled.description: When checked, indicates that any of the attributes on this table may be flagged for a text search (MAXOBJECTCFG.TEXTSEARCHENABLED)

view.description: When checked, indicates that this is a view; when clear, indicates that this is a table (MAXOBJECTCFG.ISVIEW)

viewWhere.description: Where Clause to be specified when creating the view (MAXOBJECTCFG.VIEWWHERE)

joinToObject.description: The secondary object that is used in the join for this view (MAXOBJECTCFG.JOINOBJECT)

viewSelect.description: The Select clause for the view, used by DB Config when AutoSelect is not checked (MAXOBJECTCFG.VIEWSELECT)

automaticallySelect.description: When selected, indicates a dynamic view, which automatically updates with any changes made to the data in the underlying tables (MAXOBJECTCFG.AUTOSELECT)

viewFrom.description: The From clause to be used by Database Configuration when Automatically Select? is not checked (MAXOBJECTCFG.VIEWFROM)

auditEnabled.description: When checked, indicates that Electronic Auditing (EAUDIT) is enabled for this object (MAXOBJECTCFG.EAUDITENABLED)

auditTable.description: Name of the Audit Table, if EAUDIT is enabled (MAXOBJECTCFG.EAUDITTBNAME)

eAuditFilter.description: User defined filter for an Electronic Audit record (MAXOBJECTCFG.EAUDITFILTER)

eSignatureFilter.description: User defined filter for an Electronic Signature (MAXOBJECTCFG.ESIGFILTER)

attributes.description: The attributes for the Maximo object

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the attirbute should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of attribute attributes whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the attribute already exists. Ignored when the attribute is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

attribute.description: Standard Maximo name of the attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.ATTRIBUTENAME)

description.description: A clear description of this attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.REMARKS)

length.description: The number characters that can be entered into this attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.LENGTH)

scale.description: The column scale (if numeric). Number of digits to the right of the decimal point if the data type is DECIMAL or DURATION (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.SCALE)

searchType.description: Determines how the attribute is searched (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.SEARCHTYPE)

required.description: When checked, indicates that a value is required in this field (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.REQUIRED)

title.description: A clear, short column identifier to be substituted in messages, screen labels, etc (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.TITLE)

domain.description: Name of the validation domain for this attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.DOMAINID)

column.description: The name of the column within the database table (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.COLUMNNAME)

sameAsObject.description: SameAsObject + SameAsAttribute indicate the master attribute that controls the maxtype, length, and scale of this attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.SAMEASOBJECT)

sameAsAttribute.description: SameAsObject + SameAsAttribute indicate the master attribute that controls the maxtype, length, and scale of this attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.SAMEASATTRIBUTE)

localizable.description: Identifies whether the value of this attribute can be localized (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.LOCALIZABLE)

persistent.description: When checked, indicates that this attribute (for a persistent view or table) is saved to the database (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.PERSISTENT)

mustBe.description: When checked, indicates that Maxtype, Length, and Scale of the attribute can NOT be changed. When cleared, indicates that they can be changed (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.MUSTBE)

positive.description: For a numeric field, when checked, only positive values (and zero) are allowed; when cleared, both positive and negative values are allowed (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.ISPOSITIVE)

canAutonumber.description: When checked, indicates that this attribute is able to support autokey (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.CANAUTONUM)

longDescriptionOwner.description: When checked, indicates that this a Long Description owner (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.ISLDOWNER)

sequenceName.description: The name of the sequence to be used for generating values for this attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.SEQUENCENAME)

auditEnabled.description: When checked, indicates that Electronic Auditing (EAUDIT) is enabled for this attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.EAUDITENABLED)

multilanguageSupported.description: When checked, indicates that this column supports multilanguage values (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.MLSUPPORTED)

multilanguageInUse.description: When checked, indicates that multilanguage is in use for this column. This can be set only if MLSupported is checked (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.MLINUSE)

eSignatureEnabled.description: When checked, indicates that Electronic Signature (ESIG) is enabled for this attribute (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.ESIGENABLED)

primaryColumn.description: If a value exists in this field, it indicates that the column is used by business object components when constructing a dynamic where clause to update or delete a row in the database. Values in the Primary column must be sequential, unique, and greater than zero (MAXATTRIBUTECFG.PRIMARYKEYCOLSEQ)

indexes.description: The indexes for the Maximo object

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the index should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

enforceUniqueness.description: When checked, indicates that the index is unique (MAXSYSINDEXES.UNIQUERULE)

clusteredIndex.description: SQL Server only - Clustered Index Flag (1=Clustered, 0=Non-Clustered) (MAXSYSINDEXES.CLUSTERRULE)

required.description: When checked, indicates that the index is required by the system (MAXSYSINDEXES.REQUIRED)

textSearchIndex.description: Indicates whether this index has been created to enabvle text search (MAXSYSINDEXES.TEXTSEARCH)

storagePartition.description: Database dependent, named storage partition, for the table. This is Tablespace for Oracle and Segment for Microsoft SQLServer (MAXSYSINDEXES.STORAGEPARTITION)

ascending.description: When checked, indicates that this is an ascending key (MAXSYSKEYS.ORDERING)

relationships.description: The relationships for the Maximo object

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the relationship should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of relationship attributes whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the relationship already exists. Ignored when the relationship is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

child.description: Table name of the related child (MAXRELATIONSHIP.CHILD)

remarks.description: A clear description of the relationship (MAXRELATIONSHIP.REMARKS)

whereClause.description: The clause used to set the condition for the join. If this condition is not met, the tables will not be joined (MAXRELATIONSHIP.WHERECLAUSE)

cardinality.description: Is the database relationship single or multiple? (MAXRELATIONSHIP.CARDINALITY) Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !SINGLE!.
cardinality.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !SINGLE!.

dbJoinRequired.description: Identifies whether the relationship join is required (MAXRELATIONSHIP.DBJOINREQUIRED)

isDefault.description: Flag used for default relationship between two objects

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the action should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of action properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the action already exists. Naming actionGroup keeps the group members the customer added. Ignored when the action is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

action.description: The name of the Maximo action (ACTION.ACTION)

description.description: The description of the Maximo action (ACTION.DESCRIPTION)

senderSysId.description: The sender system ID for the Maximo action (ACTION.SENDERSYSID)

type.description: The type of Maximo action (ACTION.TYPE). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !CUSTOM!.
type.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !CUSTOM!.

useWith.description: Indicates where the Maximo action can be used (ACTION.USEWITH). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !ALL!.
useWith.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !ALL!.

value.description: The action value. CUSTOM actions deploy to ACTION.VALUE; other action types deploy to ACTION.VALUE2.

objectName.description: The object associated with the Maximo action (ACTION.OBJECTNAME). A GROUP action run by an escalation point takes the escalation's object.

actionGroup.description: An array of group members for GROUP actions.

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the query should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of query properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the query already exists. Ignored when the query is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

app.description: The application for the Maximo query (QUERY.APP)

clause.description: The where clause for the Maximo query (QUERY.CLAUSE)

clauseName.description: The name of the Maximo query (QUERY.CLAUSENAME)

description.description: The description of the Maximo query (QUERY.DESCRIPTION)

intObjectName.description: The integration object name for the Maximo query (QUERY.INTOBJECTNAME)

isPublic.description: Whether the Maximo query is public (QUERY.ISPUBLIC)

isUserList.description: Whether the Maximo query is used as a user list (QUERY.ISUSERLIST)

notes.description: The notes for the Maximo query (QUERY.NOTES)

owner.description: The owner of the Maximo query (QUERY.OWNER)

priority.description: The priority of the Maximo query (QUERY.PRIORITY)

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the escalation should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of escalation properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the escalation already exists. Naming escRefPoint keeps the escalation points the customer added. Ignored when the escalation is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

escalation.description: The name of the Maximo escalation (ESCALATION.ESCALATION)

description.description: The description of the Maximo escalation (ESCALATION.DESCRIPTION)

objectName.description: The object associated with the Maximo escalation (ESCALATION.OBJECTNAME)

active.description: Whether the Maximo escalation is active (ESCALATION.ACTIVE)

instanceName.description: The escalation cron task instance name (ESCALATION.INSTANCENAME)

escStatusFlag.description: Whether the escalation status flag is enabled (ESCALATION.ESCSTATUSFLAG)

slaNum.description: The SLA associated with the escalation (ESCALATION.SLANUM)

_retain.description: Names of escalation point properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when an escalation point with this refPointNum already exists. Naming escNotification keeps the notifications the customer added. Ignored when the escalation point is created.

intervalUom.description: The escalation point interval unit of measure (ESCREFPOINT.INTERVALUOM). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !HOURS!.
intervalUom.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !HOURS!.

eventCondition.description: The condition a record must also meet to reach the escalation point (ESCREFPOINT.EVENTCONDITION)

calcCalendar.description: The calendar the elapsed interval is calculated with (ESCREFPOINT.CALCCALENDAR)

calcShift.description: The shift the elapsed interval is calculated with (ESCREFPOINT.CALCSHIFT)

calcOrgId.description: The organization of the calendar the elapsed interval is calculated with (ESCREFPOINT.CALCORGID)

action.description: The action the escalation point runs (ESCREFPOINT.ACTION): a GROUP action whose objectName is the escalation's object, since Maximo 9 accepts nothing else. Each escalation point of an escalation needs its own action. It must name an existing action: list it under actions ahead of escalations in the same file, or deploy it first.

escNotification.description: An array of notifications for the escalation point.

_retain.description: Names of integration object properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the integration object already exists. Naming a collection, such as maxIntObjDetail, sigOption, osOSLCAction, oslcQuery or queryTemplate, also keeps the rows the customer added to it. Ignored when the integration object is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the integration object should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

intObjectName.description: Identifies the integration object. This value must be unique.

description.description: Describes the integration object.

useWith.description: The applications that can use the object structure (MAXINTOBJECT.USEWITH): INTEGRATION for the integration applications, MIGRATIONMGR for Migration Manager, OSLC for the REST and OSLC APIs, REPORTING for reports and WOS for Watson object structures. Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !INTEGRATION!.
useWith.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !INTEGRATION!.

useOSSecurity.description: Use Object Structure for Authorization Name

authApp.description: The specified application can authorize inbound queue-based or synchronous integration messages to this object structure. The application can also authorize export of data from this object structure.

queryOnly.description: Flag to indicate if the integration object is read-only.

flatSupported.description: This is a Boolean indicator identifying if the MOS supports Flat File/ Interface table processing. This defaults to 'N

loadQueryFromApp.description: Load Query From All Apps. This defaults to 'N

defClass.description: Path to a Java class file that contains outbound processing and filtering code. This is a processing class that is typically used to filter the content of any MOS created by Maximo. It is applicable only for Publishing and/ or filtering query responses. This class is not always required

procClass.description: Path to a Java class file that contains Inbound processing code. This is a processing class that facilitates the creation/ update of the MBOs that constitute the MOS. Note that this class does not contain any processing logic for query support it is only for facilitating Content Management (Create/ Update/ Delete) Services. This class is not always required.

module.description: The name of the module. The name must match the name of the module that is used for the associated Maximo application.

autoPagingThreshold.description: The number of records above which API responses are paged automatically (MAXINTOBJECT.AUTOPAGINGTHRESHOLD). Skipped when the Maximo version does not have the attribute.

maxIntObjDetail.description: The Maximo objects included in the integration object.

_retain.description: Names of object properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when an object with this objectName, parentObjName and relation already exists. Naming maxIntObjCols keeps the columns the customer included or excluded, and naming maxIntObjAlias keeps the aliases the customer added. Ignored when the object is added.

altKey.description: A unique index that the integration framework uses to find a record in the system in place of the primary key for the object. Use an alternate key if the primary key is not known by the external system. Define the alternate key as a MAXIMO index in the Database Configuration application.

skipKeyUpdate.description: When selected, when new primary key values are received, the values are not updated in the Maximo database and the original primary key values are retained.

excludeParentKey.description: Exclude the parent key attributes from the child object

deleteOnCreate.description: Delete auto-generated data for selected child object

relation.description: Where clause used to navigate from a parent MBO to a child MBO. Relationships are predefined in Maximo. Applies only to standard (non-merged) integration objects.

objectOrder.description: Sequence in which the MEA processes child MBOs with the same parent MBO. This number is assigned when a user adds a child MBO. You can change this value in user-defined, but not in predefined (MEA-supplied), integration objects. Applies only to standard (non-merged) integration objects.

maxIntObjCols.description: Integration object column non-persistent and exclude rules.

name.description: Identifies a user defined data field. The name cannot be the same as that of any persistent or non-persistent field in the integration object, and it cannot be TRANSID. Within interface tables, user fields have a data type of ALN and a length of 50, and you cannot change those attributes. The field name must conform to XML field naming conventions.

intObjFldType.description: The type of integration object field, either EXCLUDE or NONPERSISTENT

_retain.description: Names of alias properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when an alias for this name already exists. Ignored when the alias is added.

name.description: Name of the attribute to alias

aliasName.description: The alias for the attribute being aliased

objectAppAuth.description: Object Application Authorization for this object. The records are shared by every object structure, keyed by context and the object of this detail: deploying adds or updates them and deleting the object structure leaves them in place.

_retain.description: Names of application authorization properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when this context already exists. Ignored when the authorization is added.

context.description: Specify the REST API context for the object resource (for example if the object resource URI is /rest/mbo/po, the REST API context for object po is /rest/mbo). The context is case-sensitive.

description.description: Description of the context

authApp.description: Specify an application that can authorize the request. The combination of the application and the security group of the user determines if the request is authorized.

sigOption.description: The signature security options associated with the integration object.

_retain.description: Names of signature option properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a signature option with this optionName already exists. Ignored when the signature option is added.

description.description: Signature Option Description

esigEnabled.description: Indicates Electronic signature (ESIG) is enabled for this function.

alsoGrants.description: List of other sigoptions that will be automatically granted when this sigoption is selected

alsoRevokes.description: List of other sigoptions that will be automatically revoked when this sigoption is deselected

prerequisite.description: List of other sigoptions that must be selected before this sigoption can be selected

visible.description: Indicates whether this sigoption can be granted via the Security Groups application. It will be visible and grantable if the value is 1 and not visible if the value is 0. If it is not visible, it should be granted and revoked along with another application by listing it in the ALSOGRANTS and ALSOREVOKES columns.

_retain.description: Names of action properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when an action with this name already exists. Ignored when the action is added.

description.description: Description of the action

optionName.description: The name of signature option name

_retain.description: Names of query properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a query with this queryType, app and clauseName already exists. Ignored when the query is added.

clauseName.description: The name of the query clause

method.description: Java Method For Query in the OS definition class

description.description: A description of the query

clause.description: The where clause for the query

script.description: The script that provides the filtering of records.

filter.description: Indicates if the query is used as a filter

_retain.description: Names of query template properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a template with this templateName and owner already exists. Naming queryTemplateAttr keeps the attributes the customer added. Ignored when the template is added.

owner.description: The person who owns the template. When omitted, Maximo assigns its default owner, and the existing template is matched as owned by the system user.

description.description: A description of the template

pageSize.description: The page size for the query response

isPublic.description: Flag that indicates that the template is public

_retain.description: Names of query template attribute properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when an attribute with this selectAttrName already exists. Ignored when the attribute is added.

alias.description: The alias for the attribute name

sortByOn.description: Indicates if the results are ordered by the attribute

ascending.description: Indicates if the results should be order ascending on the attribute

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the domain should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of domain properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the domain already exists. Ignored when the domain is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults. Naming a value collection, for example alnDomain, preserves the values the customer added that this file does not declare.

domainId.description: The domain ID for the Maximo domain (MAXDOMAIN.DOMAINID)

domainType.description: The domain type for the Maximo domain (MAXDOMAIN.DOMAINTYPE). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !MAXTABLE!.
domainType.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !MAXTABLE!.

scale.description: The scale for the Maximo domain (MAXDOMAIN.SCALE)

description.description: The description for the Maximo domain (MAXDOMAIN.DESCRIPTION)

maxType.description: The Maximo type for the Maximo domain (MAXDOMAIN.MAXTYPE)

length.description: The length for the Maximo domain (MAXDOMAIN.LENGTH)

alnDomain.description: The alnDomain values for the Maximo object

_retain.description: Names of ALN domain value properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a value with this value, orgId and siteId already exists. Ignored when the value is created. Naming maxDomValCond preserves the conditions the customer added that this file does not declare.

description.description: Description of ALN domain row (ALNDOMAIN.DESCRIPTION)

orgId.description: Organization ID of ALN domain row (ALNDOMAIN.ORGID)

siteId.description: Site ID of ALN domain row (ALNDOMAIN.SITEID)

maxDomValCond.description: An array of parameter values for the domain value conditions.

conditionNum.description: Condition number for the domain value condition (MAXDOMVALCOND.CONDITIONNUM)

objectName.description: Object name for the domain value condition (MAXDOMVALCOND.OBJECTNAME)

numericDomain.description: The numericDomain values for the Maximo object

_retain.description: Names of NUMERIC domain value properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a value with this value, orgId and siteId already exists. Ignored when the value is created. Naming maxDomValCond preserves the conditions the customer added that this file does not declare.

description.description: Description of NUMERIC domain row (NUMERICDOMAIN.DESCRIPTION)

orgId.description: Organization ID of NUMERIC domain row (NUMERICDOMAIN.ORGID)

siteId.description: Site ID of NUMERIC domain row (NUMERICDOMAIN.SITEID)

maxDomValCond.description: An array of parameter values for the domain value conditions.

conditionNum.description: Condition number for the domain value condition (MAXDOMVALCOND.CONDITIONNUM)

objectName.description: Object name for the domain value condition (MAXDOMVALCOND.OBJECTNAME)

numRangeDomain.description: The numericDomain values for the Maximo object

rangeSegment.description: Range segment for NUMRANGE domain row (NUMRANGEDOMAIN.RANGESEGMENT)

_retain.description: Names of NUMRANGE domain segment properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a segment with this rangeSegment, orgId and siteId already exists. Ignored when the segment is created.

rangeMinimum.description: Range minimum of NUMRANGE domain row (NUMRANGEDOMAIN.RANGEMINIMUM). Prefer a number, a string is parsed in the locale of the target server.

rangeMaximum.description: Range maximum of NUMRANGE domain row (NUMRANGEDOMAIN.RANGEMAXIMUM). Prefer a number, a string is parsed in the locale of the target server.

rangeInterval.description: Range interval of NUMRANGE domain row (NUMRANGEDOMAIN.RANGEINTERVAL). Prefer a number, a string is parsed in the locale of the target server.

orgId.description: Organization ID of NUMRANGE domain row (NUMRANGEDOMAIN.ORGID)

siteId.description: Site ID of NUMRANGE domain row (NUMRANGEDOMAIN.SITEID)

synonymDomain.description: The synonymDomain values for the Maximo object

maxValue.description: Maximo value for SYNONYM domain row (SYNONYMDOMAIN.MAXVALUE)

description.description: Description of SYNONYM domain row (SYNONYMDOMAIN.DESCRIPTION)

orgId.description: Organization ID of SYNONYM domain row (SYNONYMDOMAIN.ORGID)

siteId.description: Site ID of SYNONYM domain row (SYNONYMDOMAIN.SITEID)

defaults.description: Defaults flag of SYNONYM domain row (SYNONYMDOMAIN.DEFAULTS)

maxDomValCond.description: An array of parameter values for the domain value conditions.

conditionNum.description: Condition number for the domain value condition (MAXDOMVALCOND.CONDITIONNUM)

objectName.description: Object name for the domain value condition (MAXDOMVALCOND.OBJECTNAME)

tableDomain.description: The tableDomain values for the Maximo object

objectName.description: Object name for TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.OBJECTNAME)

_retain.description: Names of TABLE domain row properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a row with this orgId and siteId already exists. Ignored when the row is created.

validtnWhereClause.description: Validation where clause of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.VALIDTNWHERECLAUSE)

listWhereClause.description: List where clause of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.LISTWHERECLAUSE)

errorResourceBundle.description: Error resource bundle of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.ERRORRESOURCBUNDLE)

errorAccessKey.description: Error access key of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.ERRORACCESSKEY)

Ignored when the row is created. Naming crossoverFields preserves the fields the customer added that this file does not declare.

validtnWhereClause.description: Validation where clause of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.VALIDTNWHERECLAUSE)

listWhereClause.description: List where clause of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.LISTWHERECLAUSE)

errorResourceBundle.description: Error resource bundle of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.ERRORRESOURCBUNDLE)

errorAccessKey.description: Error access key of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.ERRORACCESSKEY)

orgId.description: Organization ID of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.ORGID)

siteId.description: Site ID of TABLE domain row (TABLEDOMAIN.SITEID)

crossoverFields.description: An array of parameter values for the crossover fields.

sourceField.description: Source field for the crossover domain row (CROSSOVERDOMAIN.SOURCEFIELD)

destField.description: Destination field name for the crossover domain row (CROSSOVERDOMAIN.DESTFIELD)

_retain.description: Names of crossover field properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a field with this sourceField and destField already exists. Ignored when the field is created.

copyEvenIfSrcNull.description: Copy even if source is null flag for the crossover domain row (CROSSOVERDOMAIN.COPYEVENIFSRCNULL)

copyOnlyIfDestNull.description: Copy only if destination is null flag for the crossover domain row (CROSSOVERDOMAIN.COPYONLYIFDESTNULL)

sourceCondition.description: Source condition for the crossover domain row (CROSSOVERDOMAIN.SOURCECONDITION)

destCondition.description: Destination condition for the crossover domain row (CROSSOVERDOMAIN.DESTCONDITION)

sequence.description: Sequence for the crossover domain row (CROSSOVERDOMAIN.SEQUENCE)

endPoint.title: End Point
endPoint.description: A Maximo integration end point. Its handler defines which properties it has, so a property can only be given a value, never added, removed or renamed.

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the end point should be deleted if it exists from the target system. Maximo refuses to delete an end point that is still in use.

_retain.description: Names of end point properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the end point already exists. Ignored when the end point is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

endPointName.description: The name of the end point (MAXENDPOINT.ENDPOINTNAME)

description.description: The description of the end point (MAXENDPOINT.DESCRIPTION)

handlerName.description: The name of an existing handler (MAXENDPOINT.HANDLERNAME), for example HTTP. Required to create the end point, and cannot be changed once it exists.

properties.description: Values of the properties the handler defines. Properties not listed, and values a listed property omits, are left unchanged.

property.description: The name of a property the handler defines (MAXENDPOINTDTL.PROPERTY)

_retain.description: Names of property values whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the end point already exists. Ignored when the end point is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

value.description: The value of a property that is not encrypted (MAXENDPOINTDTL.VALUE)

password.description: The clear text value of an encrypted property (MAXENDPOINTDTL.PASSWORD). Maximo stores it encrypted, and extraction writes it in clear text.

allowOverride.description: Whether the value can be overridden (MAXENDPOINTDTL.ALLOWOVERRIDE)

publishChannel.title: Publish Channel
publishChannel.description: A Maximo integration publish channel with its integration controls and processing rules. It is deleted and created again on every deployment, which is refused while an external system uses it.

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the publish channel should be deleted if it exists from the target system. Its processing rules are deleted with it. An embedded objectStructure is only unlinked, unless it is marked _delete too, which needs only its intObjectName. A channel an external system uses cannot be deleted.

_retain.description: Names of publish channel properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the publish channel already exists. Ignored when the publish channel is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

ifaceName.description: The name of the publish channel (MAXIFACEOUT.IFACENAME)

description.description: The description of the publish channel (MAXIFACEOUT.DESCRIPTION)

intObjectName.description: A reference to the object structure the channel publishes (MAXIFACEOUT.INTOBJECTNAME), which is never changed or deleted. Required unless objectStructure is given.

objectStructure.description: The object structure the channel publishes, embedded instead of an intObjectName reference. Extraction embeds a user defined object structure and references a predefined one by intObjectName. It is deleted and created again with the channel. A predefined object structure is skipped with a warning; reference it by intObjectName instead. An object structure the channel used before under another name is unlinked and kept; delete it on the top level or by embedding it with _delete in a deleted channel.

listener.description: Whether the event listener is enabled (MAXIFACEOUT.LISTENER)

retainMbos.description: Whether the objects are kept in memory for processing (MAXIFACEOUT.RETAINMBOS)

skipDiffObject.description: Whether a message without changes to the object structure is skipped (MAXIFACEOUT.SKIPDIFFOBJECT)

storeMsg.description: Whether messages are stored in the message tracking table (MAXIFACEOUT.STOREMSG)

eventFilterClass.description: The Java class that filters events (MAXIFACEOUT.EVENTFILTERCLASS)

extMsgIdField.description: The field that identifies a stored message (MAXIFACEOUT.EXTMSGIDFIELD)

searchField.description: The fields a stored message is searched by (MAXIFACEOUT.SEARCHFIELD)

integrationControls.description: The integration controls of the channel.

processingRules.description: The processing rules of the channel, in the order they apply. Rules not listed are deleted.

integrationControl.title: Integration Control
integrationControl.description: An integration control of a publish channel or an enterprise service, deleted and created again with the record that owns it.

control.description: The name of an integration control (MAXIFACECONTROL.IFACECONTROL)

processingRule.title: Processing Rule
processingRule.description: An integration processing rule with its conditions, fields and columns, deleted and created again with the record that owns it.

_retain.description: Names of processing rule properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the record that owns the rule already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

procName.description: The name of the processing rule (MAXIFACEPROC.PROCNAME)

action.description: What the rule does (MAXIFACEPROC.PROCTYPE). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !SKIP!.
action.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !SKIP!.

objectName.description: The object the rule applies to (MAXIFACEPROC.OBJECTNAME)

hierarchyPath.description: The path of the object in the object structure (MAXIFACEPROC.HIERARCHYPATH). Defaults to the path of objectName in the object structure.

description.description: The description of the processing rule (MAXIFACEPROC.DESCRIPTION)

className.description: The Java class of a custom rule (MAXIFACEPROC.CLASSNAME)

procMessage.description: The message a STOP rule raises (MAXIFACEPROC.PROCMESSAGE)

applyOnInsert.description: Whether the rule applies when a record is added (MAXIFACEPROC.APPLYONINSERT)

applyOnUpdate.description: Whether the rule applies when a record is updated (MAXIFACEPROC.APPLYONUPDATE)

applyOnDelete.description: Whether the rule applies when a record is deleted (MAXIFACEPROC.APPLYONDELETE)

conditions.description: The conditions of the rule. Conditions not listed are deleted.

_retain.description: Names of condition properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the record that owns the rule already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

condition.description: The number of the condition (MAXIFACECOND.CONDITION). The conditions of a rule are evaluated with OR, the details of a condition with AND.

details.description: The details of the condition. Details not listed are deleted.

_retain.description: Names of condition detail properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the record that owns the rule already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

condSequence.description: The sequence of the condition detail (MAXCONDDETAIL.CONDSEQUENCE)

condType.description: The type of the condition detail (MAXCONDDETAIL.CONDTYPE)

evalType.description: How the value is evaluated (MAXCONDDETAIL.EVALTYPE). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !EQUALS!.
evalType.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !EQUALS!.

changeType.description: Whether the condition applies to any value or only a changed one (MAXCONDDETAIL.CHANGETYPE). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !ALWAYS!.
changeType.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !ALWAYS!.

compareType.description: What the value is compared with (MAXCONDDETAIL.COMPARETYPE)

mboColumnName.description: The field of the object the condition evaluates (MAXCONDDETAIL.MBOCOLUMNNAME)

relation.description: The relationship to the object the condition evaluates (MAXCONDDETAIL.RELATION)

value.description: The value or integration control compared with (MAXCONDDETAIL.VALUE)

glOrder.description: The general ledger component the condition evaluates (MAXCONDDETAIL.GLORDER)

fields.description: The fields a SET or REPLACE rule sets. Fields not listed are deleted.

_retain.description: Names of field properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the record that owns the rule already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

replaceNull.description: Whether the field is set only when it has no value (MAXREPLACEPROC.REPLACENULL)

value.description: The value, field or field of the related object that sets the field (MAXREPLACEPROC.VALUE)

mboName.description: The object the value comes from (MAXREPLACEPROC.MBONAME)

relation.description: The relationship to the object the value comes from (MAXREPLACEPROC.RELATION)

columns.description: The fields a COMBINE or SPLIT rule uses. Columns not listed are deleted.

_retain.description: Names of column properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the record that owns the rule already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

fieldName.description: The field the rule combines or splits on (MAXPROCCOLS.FIELDNAME)

ifaceControl.description: The integration control that maps the field (MAXPROCCOLS.IFACECONTROL)

enterpriseService.title: Enterprise Service
enterpriseService.description: A Maximo integration enterprise service with its additional object structures, gateway properties, integration controls and processing rules. It is deleted and created again on every deployment, which is refused while an external system uses it.

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the enterprise service should be deleted if it exists from the target system. Its processing rules are deleted with it. An embedded objectStructure is only unlinked, unless it is marked _delete too, which needs only its intObjectName. A service an external system uses, or a predefined service, cannot be deleted.

_retain.description: Names of enterprise service properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the enterprise service already exists. Ignored when the enterprise service is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

ifaceName.description: The name of the enterprise service (MAXIFACEIN.IFACENAME)

description.description: The description of the enterprise service (MAXIFACEIN.DESCRIPTION)

intObjectName.description: A reference to the object structure the service receives (MAXIFACEIN.INTOBJECTNAME), which is never changed or deleted. Required unless objectStructure is given.

objectStructure.description: The object structure the service receives, embedded instead of an intObjectName reference. Extraction embeds a user defined object structure and references a predefined one by intObjectName. It is deleted and created again with the service. A predefined object structure is skipped with a warning; reference it by intObjectName instead. An object structure the service used before under another name is unlinked and kept; delete it on the top level or by embedding it with _delete in a deleted service.

ifaceControl.description: The integration control that selects the processing for the service (MAXIFACEIN.IFACECONTROL)

useExternalSchema.description: Whether the service uses an external schema, which makes the schema properties editable (MAXIFACEIN.USEEXTERNALSCHEMA)

splitTag.description: The XML tag that splits an inbound message (MAXIFACEIN.SPLITTAG)

replyUserExitClass.description: The Java reply user exit class (MAXIFACEIN.REPLYUSEREXITCLASS)

storeMsg.description: Whether messages are stored in the message tracking table (MAXIFACEIN.STOREMSG)

extMsgIdField.description: The field that identifies a stored message (MAXIFACEIN.EXTMSGIDFIELD)

searchField.description: The fields a stored message is searched by (MAXIFACEIN.SEARCHFIELD)

interpreterClass.description: The class that interprets the inbound message for the gateway (MAXIFACEIN.INTERPRETERCLASS)

additionalObjectStructures.description: The additional object structures of the service, in the order they apply. Object structures not listed are removed from it.

_retain.description: Names of additional object structure properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the enterprise service already exists. Ignored when the enterprise service is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

intObjectName.description: The name of the additional object structure (MAXIFACEINDETAIL.INTOBJECTNAME)

ifaceMapOrder.description: The order the object structure applies in (MAXIFACEINDETAIL.IFACEMAPORDER)

gatewayProperties.description: The gateway properties of the service. Properties not listed are removed from it.

_retain.description: Names of gateway property properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the enterprise service already exists. Ignored when the enterprise service is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

param.description: The name of the gateway property (MAXIFACETYPEPROP.PARAM)

value.description: The value of the gateway property (MAXIFACETYPEPROP.VALUE)

isXmlTag.description: Whether the value is taken from an XML tag of the message (MAXIFACETYPEPROP.ISXMLTAG)

integrationControls.description: The integration controls of the service.

processingRules.description: The processing rules of the object structure, in the order they apply. Rules not listed are deleted.

objectProcessingRules.description: The processing rules of the objects in the object structure, in the order they apply. Rules not listed are deleted.

externalSystem.title: External System
externalSystem.description: A Maximo integration external system with its publish channels, enterprise services and integration controls. It is deleted and created again on every deployment, with its links and control values. A publish channel or enterprise service is either referenced by ifaceName or embedded, and an embedded one is deleted and created again with the system.

_delete.description: Deletes the external system, which is disabled first. Embedded publish channels and enterprise services marked _delete are deleted with it, and the others are kept.

_retain.description: Names of external system properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the external system already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

extSysName.description: The name of the external system (MAXEXTSYSTEM.EXTSYSNAME)

description.description: The description of the external system (MAXEXTSYSTEM.DESCRIPTION)

endPointName.description: The default end point of the external system (MAXEXTSYSTEM.ENDPOINTNAME)

langCode.description: The language of the external system (MAXEXTSYSTEM.LANGCODE). Defaults to the base language.

jmsMsgEncoding.description: The encoding of JMS text messages (MAXEXTSYSTEM.JMSMSGENCODING)

enabled.description: Whether the external system is enabled (MAXEXTSYSTEM.ENABLED). Set after the links and controls are added.

publishChannels.description: The publish channels of the external system (MAXEXTIFACEOUT).

enterpriseServices.description: The enterprise services of the external system (MAXEXTIFACEIN).

integrationControls.description: The integration control values of the external system (MAXEXTSYSCONTROL). A control that is not listed takes the default value of its definition.

externalSystemPublishChannel.title: External System Publish Channel
externalSystemPublishChannel.description: A publish channel of an external system, referenced by ifaceName or embedded.

_retain.description: Names of external system publish channel properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the external system already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

ifaceName.description: The name of a publish channel the system uses, referenced instead of embedded

publishChannel.description: The publish channel the system uses, embedded instead of an ifaceName reference. Extraction embeds a user defined publish channel that no other external system uses, and references any other by ifaceName. It is deleted and created again with the system, or deleted and unlinked when marked _delete, which is refused while another external system uses it. A predefined publish channel is skipped with a warning; reference it by ifaceName instead.

enabled.description: Whether the publish channel is enabled for the system

endPointName.description: The end point of the publish channel for the system (MAXEXTIFACEOUT.ENDPOINTNAME). Defaults to the end point of the system.

isContinuousQueue.description: Whether the publish channel uses the continuous queue rather than the sequential one

externalSystemEnterpriseService.title: External System Enterprise Service
externalSystemEnterpriseService.description: An enterprise service of an external system, referenced by ifaceName or embedded.

_retain.description: Names of external system enterprise service properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the external system already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

ifaceName.description: The name of an enterprise service the system uses, referenced instead of embedded

enterpriseService.description: The enterprise service the system uses, embedded instead of an ifaceName reference. Extraction embeds a user defined enterprise service that no other external system uses, and references any other by ifaceName. It is deleted and created again with the system, or deleted and unlinked when marked _delete, which is refused while another external system uses it. A predefined enterprise service is skipped with a warning; reference it by ifaceName instead.

enabled.description: Whether the enterprise service is enabled for the system

isContinuousQueue.description: Whether the enterprise service uses the continuous queue rather than the sequential one

externalSystemIntegrationControl.title: External System Integration Control
externalSystemIntegrationControl.description: The values of an integration control for an external system. The control type decides which value applies: value for VALUE, isTrue for BOOLEAN, listValues for LIST and crossReferenceValues for CROSSREFERENCE. Any other is refused.

_retain.description: Names of integration control properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the external system already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

control.description: The name of an integration control (MAXIFACECONTROL.IFACECONTROL)

value.description: The value of a VALUE control (MAXEXTSYSCONTROL.VALUE). A value of a control with a synonym domain takes the localized value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !VALUE!.

isTrue.description: The value of a BOOLEAN control (MAXEXTSYSCONTROL.ISTRUE)

listValues.description: The values of a LIST control (MAXEXTLISTVAL). A value of a control with a synonym domain takes the localized value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !VALUE!.

crossReferenceValues.description: The value pairs of a CROSSREFERENCE control (MAXEXTXREFVAL). A value of a control with a synonym domain takes the localized value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !VALUE!.

overrides.description: The organization and site values of the control (MAXEXTCTLVAL, MAXEXTBOOLVAL or MAXEXTOVER).

externalSystemIntegrationControlOverride.title: External System Integration Control Override
externalSystemIntegrationControlOverride.description: The value of an integration control for an organization or for a site, taking the same value property as the control.

_retain.description: Names of integration control override properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the external system already exists. Ignored when it is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

orgId.description: The organization of the override. Give either orgId or siteId.

siteId.description: The site of the override. Give either orgId or siteId.

value.description: The value of a VALUE control (MAXEXTCTLVAL.VALUE). A value of a control with a synonym domain takes the localized value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !VALUE!.

isTrue.description: The value of a BOOLEAN control (MAXEXTBOOLVAL.ISTRUE)

listValues.description: The values of a LIST control (MAXLISTOVERVAL). A value of a control with a synonym domain takes the localized value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !VALUE!.

crossReferenceValues.description: The value pairs of a CROSSREFERENCE control (MAXXREFOVERVAL). A value of a control with a synonym domain takes the localized value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !VALUE!.

externalSystemIntegrationControlListValu.title: External System Integration Control List Value

externalSystemIntegrationControlCrossRef.title: External System Integration Control Cross Reference Value

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the cron task should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of cron task properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the cron task already exists. Ignored when the cron task is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults. Naming cronTaskInstance preserves instances the customer added that this file does not declare.

cronTaskName.description: The name of the Cron Task (CRONTASKDEF.CRONTASKNAME)

description.description: The description of the Cron Task (CRONTASKDEF.DESCRIPTION)

className.description: The Java class name of the Cron Task implementation (CRONTASKDEF.CLASSNAME)

accessLevel.description: The access level for the Maximo Cron Task (CRONTASKDEF.ACCESSLEVEL). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !FULL!.
accessLevel.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !FULL!.

cronTaskInstance.description: An array of Maximo Cron Task instance definitions

instanceName.description: The name of the Cron Task instance (CRONTASKINSTANCE.INSTANCENAME)

_retain.description: Names of instance properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when an instance with this instanceName already exists. Ignored when the instance is created. Naming cronTaskParam preserves parameters the customer added that this file does not declare.

description.description: The description of the Cron Task instance (CRONTASKINSTANCE.DESCRIPTION)

schedule.description: The schedule of the Cron Task instance in Unix cron task format (CRONTASKINSTANCE.SCHEDULE)

active.description: Flag to indicate if the Cron Task instance is active or not (CRONTASKINSTANCE.ACTIVE)

keepHistory.description: Flag to indicate if the Cron Task instance will retain a history of runs or not (CRONTASKINSTANCE.RETAINHISTORY)

runAsUserId.description: The user Id that will be used to run the Cron Task instance, must be a valid Maximo user Id (CRONTASKINSTANCE.RUNASUSERID)

maxHistory.description: The maximum number of history records to retain (CRONTASKINSTANCE.MAXHISTORY)

cronTaskParam.description: An array of parameter values for the Cron Task instance.

parameter.description: The name of the Cron Task parameter.  The parameters are automatically added by the class and the name is matched after the parameters are added (CRONTASKPARAM.PARAMETER)

_retain.description: Names of parameter properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when a parameter with this name already exists on the instance. Ignored when the parameter is created.

value.description: The value of the Cron Task parameter (CRONTASKPARAM.VALUE)

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the logger should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of logger attributes whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the logger already exists. Ignored when the logger is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

logger.description: The base logger name for the Maximo logger (MAXLOGGER.LOGGER)

parentLogKey.description: The log key for the parent logger, this is used to find the parent logger Id (MAXLOGGER.PARENTLOGGERID)

logKey.description: The log key for the logger, if not provided defaults to log4j.logger.maximo. plus the logger name (MAXLOGGER.LOGKEY). A logger without a parent is found by this key when it is given, otherwise by its name, which must then belong to one logger only.

logLevel.description: The log level for the Maximo logger (MAXLOGGER.LOGLEVEL)

active.description: Flag to indicate if the logger is active or not (MAXLOGGER.ACTIVE)

appenders.description: A comma delimited list of appenders  Maximo logger (MAXLOGGER.APPENDERS)

parent.description: Alternate way to specify the parent logger without using the full key, provided for convenience and ease. The parentLogKey is derived by prefixing this value with 'log4j.logger.maximo.'

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the message should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of message properties whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the message already exists. Ignored when the message is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults.

msgId.description: The full message ID for the Maximo message (MAXMESSAGES.MSGID)

msgGroup.description: The group for the Maximo message (MAXMESSAGES.MSGGROUP)

msgKey.description: The key for the Maximo message (MAXMESSAGES.MSGKEY)

value.description: The value for the Maximo message (MAXMESSAGES.VALUE)

displayMethod.description: The display for the Maximo message (MAXMESSAGES.DISPLAYMETHOD)

options.description: The display options for the Maximo message (MAXMESSAGES.OPTIONS)

prefix.description: The message prefix for the Maximo message (MAXMESSAGES.MSGIDPREFIX)

suffix.description: The message suffix for the Maximo message (MAXMESSAGES.MSGIDSUFFIX)

explanation.description: The value for the Maximo message explanation (MAXMESSAGES.EXPLANATION)

operatorResponse.description: The value for the Maximo message operator response (MAXMESSAGES.OPERATORRESPONSE)

adminResponse.description: The value for the Maximo message admin response (MAXMESSAGES.ADMINRESPONSE)

systemAction.description: The value for the Maximo message system action (MAXMESSAGES.SYSTEMACTION)

_delete.description: Flag to indicate that the property should be deleted if it exists from the target system.

_retain.description: Names of property attributes whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the property already exists. Ignored when the property is created, so the values in this file are installed as the product defaults. Naming maxPropInstance also keeps the instances added in the target system.

propName.description: The name for the Maximo property (MAXPROP.PROPNAME)

description.description: The property description for the Maximo property (MAXPROP.DESCRIPTION)

domainId.description: The Maximo domain Id associated with the Maximo property. (MAXPROP.DOMAINID)

encrypted.description: Flag to indicate if the Maximo property is encrypted or not (MAXPROP.ENCRYPTED)

globalOnly.description: Flag to indicate if the Maximo property is only available in a global context or not (MAXPROP.GLOBALONLY)

instanceOnly.description: Flag to indicate if the Maximo property is only available in an instance context or not (MAXPROP.INSTANCEONLY)

liveRefresh.description: Flag to indicate if the Maximo property is able to be live refreshed or not (MAXPROP.LIVEREFRESH)

masked.description: Flag to indicate if the Maximo property is masked or not when displayed in the System Properties application (MAXPROP.MASKED)

maxType.description: The Maximo data type of the property (MAXPROP.MAXTYPE)

nullsAllowed.description: Flag to indicate if the Maximo property allows nulls or not (MAXPROP.NULLSALLOWED)

onlineChanges.description: Flag to indicate if the Maximo property may be overridden via the Maximo System Properties application or not (MAXPROP.ONLINECHANGES)

secureLevel.description: The level of access permitted for the property (MAXPROP.SECURELEVEL). Takes the localized synonym domain value of the target Maximo, or the internal value written as !PUBLIC!.
secureLevel.patternErrorMessage: A value that starts with ! must be an internal value written as !VALUE!, for example !PUBLIC!.

propValue.description: The global value for the property (MAXPROP.DISPPROPVALUE)

maximoDefault.description: The Maximo default value for the property (MAXPROP.MAXIMODEFAULT)

_retain.description: Names of property instance attributes whose existing values in the target system must be preserved when the instance already exists. Ignored when the instance is created.

serverName.description: The name of the Maximo server for the property instance (MAXPROPINSTANCE.SERVERNAME)

propValue.description: The value of the Maximo server for the property instance (MAXPROPINSTANCE.DISPPROPVALUE)

serverHost.description: The value of the Maximo server host name for the property instance (MAXPROPINSTANCE.SERVERHOST)

presentation.title: Maximo Presentation Changes
presentation.description: Ordered changes to one existing presentation. Every change of the payload is resolved before anything is written, and MAXLABELS is synchronised with the result.

app.description: The application, or the system presentation such as LIBRARY, whose presentation is changed.

changes.description: The changes, applied in order, so a change may refer to a control an earlier one added.

presentationChange.title: Presentation Change
presentationChange.description: One add, modify, move or remove.

presentationElement.title: Presentation Element
presentationElement.description: A control to add, with its attributes as string properties. If a control with the id exists it is replaced in place.

name.description: The element name, for example section or pushbutton.

id.description: The control id, unique in the presentation.

presentationReference.title: Presentation Reference
presentationReference.description: An existing control, identified by its id, with its element name as a check.

name.description: The element name, for example tab.
